fields.title: Kafka on the Shore
fields.description: A teenage runaway and an elderly man who talks to cats follow separate, strange paths that slowly converge.

fields.title: Norwegian Wood
fields.description: A man looks back on love, loss and friendship during his university years in 1960s Tokyo.

fields.title: Kokoro
fields.description: A student's friendship with an older man he calls Sensei leads to a confession about guilt and isolation after the Meiji era.

fields.title: Noli Me Tangere
fields.description: A young man returns to the Philippines from Europe and confronts abuse by the colonial authorities and the church.

fields.title: El Filibusterismo
fields.description: The sequel to Noli Me Tangere, following a vengeful return and a plot against the colonial order.
